The starting point

Bring my profile, experience and work together in my own website, connected to my CV and professional profiles. The first coming-soon page evolved into this fuller experience.

How I built it

  • Separate content and components to maintain Spanish and English versions.
  • Statically generated HTML, with links and content available without JavaScript.
  • An A+ built with procedural geometry, materials and lighting in WebGL, with dragging, keyboard controls and pause.
  • Responsive design, light and dark themes and respect for motion preferences.
  • Code and content checks, publication on Sites and sources synchronised with GitHub.

The result

A public website bringing together my experience, projects and technical notes. A foundation for new work and knowledge, with an identity of its own.
